operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Trusted identity binding
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Layer0 (`CH-01`) binds `subject_id`, `tenant_id`, and `harness_id` in every receipt; `condor/gspc_constitutional_flow.py` rejects mismatched host context before precheck.

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: No self-authorization
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: A model, tool, payment, or training result can never expand its own authority; MEOK Perspectives 1-3 apply non-compensatory vetoes (`epistemic_skeptic`, `harm_authority_guard`).

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Bounded authority
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Capability, resource, budget, and expiry bounds are checked against `constitutional_maximum` in `gspc_authority_state.py`; expansion requires explicit owner/human review (`Article 20`).

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Pre-effect commitment
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Consequential tool calls (`execute_*`, `deploy_*`, `transfer_*`) require pre-effect SHA-256 input commitment + HITL `approvalReceipt` (`Layer0.governedLocal`) + MCP `elicitation/create` `decline`/`cancel` respect (`scripts/hitl/hitl_probe.py`).

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Revocation and resume
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Revocation, expiry, and dependency drift (`SovSpace`) are rechecked at the effect boundary; uncertain effects are held for human review rather than blindly replayed.

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Measurement independence
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Execution receipts do not automatically become GSPC board rows. Candidate observations submitted to `POST /api/evidence-intake` remain `AWAITING_OPERATOR_REVIEW` (`writes_board: false`) until independent replay and operator admission.

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Signature and publication separation
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Board signing (`scripts/charter/sign-charter.py`) is owner-gated (`--execute --owner-approval`); outward publication requires `scripts/outward-gate/outward_gate.py` 100% PASS.

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Payment separation
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: x402 settlement on `/api/evidence-bundle` or `/api/receipts/batch` never buys a score, rank, or admission; `/api/gspc` and `/verify` remain free forever.

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Privacy and rights gate
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: `gspc-harvest.mjs` sets `model_training: false` on all intake receipts; `gspc_care_multiprospective_miner.py` enforces permissive-only license gates (`MIT`, `Apache-2.0`, `CC-BY-4.0`, `ODC-By`).

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Security and secret minimization
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: `Layer0.localConstitutionalPrecheck` blocks raw secret fields (`api_key`, `password`, `private_key`, `access_token`); `scripts/hitl/hitl_probe.py` flags MCP servers that request sensitive fields in `form` mode.

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Appeal and understandable reasons
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Every denial, hold, or three-state verify verdict (`VALID | INVALID | UNCHECKABLE`) provides an explicit one-line reason and evidence pointer.

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: Learning is not authority
operational_controls_ch01_ch16.hitl_and_layer0_enforcement: Academy HITL modules, simulations, and benchmark runs never grant execution or compliance authority (`csoai_him_engine.py`).

operational_controls_ch01_ch16.name: No regulatory determination

first_principles_institutional_precedent.institution: Underwriters Laboratories (UL, founded 1894 by William Henry Merrill)
first_principles_institutional_precedent.first_principles_origin: Started by one electrical inspector above a fire station testing electrical insulation fires. Manufacturers did not ask to be tested; fire insurers refused to underwrite buildings without independent test data.
first_principles_institutional_precedent.csoai_structural_lesson: Never sell a grade to a vendor. Publish deterministic failure modes (such as CareBench worst-5% tail harm cvar05_harm=0.9895 and S-1 risk crosswalks) that D&O insurers, IPO underwriters, and enterprise risk officers need before underwriting AI deployment risk.

first_principles_institutional_precedent.first_principles_origin: Started by one founder compiling public railroad bond statistics and balance-sheet ratios from public filings without asking any railroad company for permission.

first_principles_institutional_precedent.institution: IETF & W3C ('Rough Consensus and Running Code' / RFC 8615 /.well-known/)

first_principles_institutional_precedent.csoai_structural_lesson: Serve the Operational Constitutional Harness Charter at `/.well-known/constitutional-harness.json`, the verifier at `/signed/verify-card.mjs`, and the zero-dependency SDK in `packages/layer0-js`.

first_principles_institutional_precedent.first_principles_origin: Solved rogue CA issuance by requiring every certificate to be appended to a publicly auditable, cryptographically hashed Merkle tree that any browser or monitor can check for free.
first_principles_institutional_precedent.csoai_structural_lesson: CSOAI's `/root.json` (with OpenTimestamps proof), `/api/corrections`, and `/.well-known/charter-amendments.json` are append-only logs. Verification at https://councilof.ai/verify is free forever and requires no account.

first_principles_institutional_precedent.institution: Consumer Reports (1936) & Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS, 1959)
first_principles_institutional_precedent.first_principles_origin: Maintained independence by buying products anonymously at retail, prohibiting manufacturer promotional badges, and publishing test protocols so any lab could reproduce the crash test.
first_principles_institutional_precedent.csoai_structural_lesson: Doctrine #1 & #8: Measurement, never certification; CSOAI removes its own models from every fleet comparison (`EXCLUDED_OWN_MODEL`) and tests commercial inference endpoints in the wild (`serving-fidelity`).

first_principles_institutional_precedent.institution: Linux Foundation / OpenSSF Scorecard / AAIF (in-toto, OTel, MCP, A2A)

living_stamp.source: boards-v2 + gold-run-3090; axis roster of this deploy (not a live re-fetch)

preimage.source: boards-v2 + gold-run-3090; axis roster of this deploy (not a live re-fetch)

living_stamp.sig_input: Ed25519 over the RAW UTF-8 BYTES (not a digest) of canonical JSON of the `preimage` object only ({schema, gold_run, source, axes}). Canonical JSON: object keys sorted by code point, recursively; no whitespace (separators ',' and ':'); non-ASCII emitted LITERALLY as UTF-8 (ensure_ascii=False); numbers by ECMAScript Number::toString (integral float renders 0, not 0.0). Envelope fields (signature, public_key_x, sig_input, signer, signed, signer_anchored, alg, verification_state, verifiable, superseded, tracked_as, verify) are NOT in the preimage.
living_stamp.verify: fetch https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json → #board-attestation-1 → Ed25519-verify `signature` over the raw UTF-8 bytes of canonical(`preimage`), ensure_ascii=False

superseded.sig_input: sha256(canonical board minus signature fields, sort_keys) — AS PUBLISHED WHEN SIGNED, AND NOT REPRODUCIBLE. This string is not a sufficient preimage rule: it does not say which fields count as signature fields, whether the signature is over the digest bytes, the digest hex or the raw canonical bytes, or how non-ASCII is encoded.
superseded.unverifiable_note: DO NOT TREAT THIS AS A VALID ATTESTATION. This stamp was signed, but no published bytes reproduce it: 58,184 readings were attempted on 2026-08-26 across both published signatures, all five published keys, nine candidate payloads, raw/digest/hex message forms, both ensure_ascii settings and every drop-set of up to three fields. None verified. Two different signatures are published for this one stamp (53aa09fa… in /signed/board_living.json, bd199fd3… here), the signer is not among the verification methods in /.well-known/did.json, and board_living.json's own note says its axes were re-snapshotted from the live board six days after the signature date — so the signed bytes are not the published bytes. Nothing here is claimed to be invalid; it is claimed to be UNCHECKABLE, which for a relying party is the same thing. The two attestations on this site that DO verify are the signed card index (/signed/card_index.json, corpus 3 in council-os/CARD-CORPORA.md; whole-store check at /api/state → card_chain.bodies_verified_valid) under #card-attestation-1, and site_attestation on this payload under #board-attestation-1; check those instead. The older 150-card figure was a checked subset of that same chain, not a separate corpus.
superseded.supersedes_note: site_attestation on this payload signs this whole body, including this block. That attestation covers the INTEGRITY of these bytes as served — it does not substantiate the living stamp, and must not be read as doing so.
